title: Florida channel wakes up with an unexplained metal filling
summary: Greg tells of Florida channel wakes up with an unexplained metal filling, about early 1970s at Florida, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: behold, he wakes up when he realizes he has a metal filling that he never had.

plain: A researcher called Greg, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, tells a story from the early 1970s in Florida drawn from a book called The Stargate Conspiracy. It involves a medium, a person said to channel messages from beyond, linked to Phyllis Schlemmer and the researcher Andrija Puharich, who say they were in contact with an alien council. Greg says the man woke up to find a metal filling in his tooth that he never had before, which, if true, would be physical evidence of something done to him from outside.
